description: The sum of revenue contributions emerging from local, state, and federal sources.

label: Total federal revenue
Federal revenue through the state for the Child Nutrition Act
description: Aid from formula grants distributed through state government agencies. Includes revenues from National School Lunch, Special Milk, School Breakfast, and a la carte programs. Does not include the value of donated commodities.

label: Federal revenue through the state for Title I
description: Aid from formula grants distributed through state government agencies, including revenues authorized by Title I of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act of 1965 (P.L. 89-10). Includes basic, concentration, targeted, and finance incentive grants

label: Federal revenue through the state for the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act
description: Revenues awarded under the Individuals With Disabilities Act (P.L. 91-230). Includes formula grants authorized in Part B of this legislation. Excludes project grants authorized in Part D. These project grants are reported in the federal revenue, direct, variable.

label: Federal revenue through the state for math, science, and teacher quality
description: Aid from formula grants distributed through state government agencies including math, science, and teacher quality formula and project grants provided under Title II-A and B of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (ESEA) as reauthorized by the No Child Left Behind Act of 2001 (NCLB).

label: Federal revenue through the state for safe and drug-free schools
description: Aid from formula grants distributed through state government agencies. This includes project grants for safe and drug-free schools distributed under Title IV-A of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (ESEA) as reauthorized by the the No Child Left Behind Act of 2001 (NCLB).

label: Federal revenue through the state for vocational and tech education
description: Aid from formula grants distributed through state government agencies. This includes revenues from formula grants authorized by the Carl D. Perkins Career and Technical Education Improvement Act of 2006 (Public Law 105-332).

label: Federal revenue through the state for bilingual education
description: Aid from formula grants distributed through state government agencies for billingual education, including project grants for bilingual education provided under Title III of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (ESEA) as reauthorized by the No Child Left Behind Act of 2001 (NCLB).

label: Federal revenue through the state for other purposes
description: Aid from formula grants distributed through state government agencies. This includes: revenues from other formula grant programs distributed through state governments, such as mathematics, science, and teacher quality under Title II (Parts A and B); safe and drug-free schools; and the Adult Education Act (Part B).

description: Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). label: Current expenditures for instructional staff support services
description: Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). Includes payments from all funds for salaries, employee benefits, supplies, materials, and contractual services; excludes capital outlay, debt service, and interfund transfers.

label: Current expenditures for general administration support services
description: Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). Includes payments from all funds for salaries, employee benefits, supplies, materials, and contractual services; excludes capital outlay, debt service, and interfund transfers. Includes expenditures for board of education and executive administration (office of the superintendent) services.

label: Current expenditures for school administration support services
description: Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). Includes payments from all funds for salaries, employee benefits, supplies, materials, and contractual services; excludes capital outlay, debt service, and interfund transfers.  Includes expenditures for the office of the principal services.

label: Current expenditures for support services for operation and maintenance of plant
description: Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). Includes payments from all funds for salaries, employee benefits, supplies, materials, and contractual services; excludes capital outlay, debt service, and interfund transfers.  Includes expenditures for building services (heating, electricity, air conditioning, property insurance), care and upkeep of grounds and equipment, nonstudent transportation vehicle operation and maintenance, and security services.

label: Current expenditures for student transportation support services
description: Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). Includes payments from all funds for salaries, employee benefits, supplies, materials, and contractual services; excludes capital outlay, debt service, and interfund transfers. Includes expenditures for the transportation of public school students, including vehicle operation, monitoring riders, and vehicle servicing and maintenance.

label: Current expenditures for business, central, and other support services
description: Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). Includes payments from all funds for salaries, employee benefits, supplies, materials, and contractual services; excludes capital outlay, debt service, and interfund transfers. Includes expenditure for business support, central support, and other support services. Business support services include payments for fiscal services (budgeting, receiving and disbursing funds, payroll, internal auditing, and accounting), purchasing, warehousing, supply distribution, printing, publishing, and duplicating services. Central support services include planning, research, development, and evaluation services. They also include information services, staff services (recruitment, staff accounting, noninstructional in-service training, staff health services), and data processing services.

label: Current expenditures for support services for nonspecified purposes
description:
Relates to the support services functions (series 2000) defined in Financial Accounting for Local and State School Systems (National Center for Education Statistics 2009). Includes payments from all funds for salaries, employee benefits, supplies, materials, and contractual services; excludes capital outlay, debt service, and interfund transfers. Nonspecified expenditures pertain to more than one of the support services categories. In some cases, reporting units could not provide distinct expenditure amounts for each support services category. These expenditures are included in â€œnonspecifiedâ€
instead of â€œother support services.â€
